title: faceto — event-sourced (the log is truth; the model is a projection replayed from it) · hotspot lane

label: Who mints ids for added elements & regions?

resolution: Ids are minted server-side, never by the client: <PREFIX><N>, one past the highest suffix ever added under that lane's prefix in the log (removed-but-not-compacted ids stay reserved), computed under the appends lock so concurrent adds can't collide. Regions share the rule via resolve_region_id (K<n>).

label: Event schema versioning / migration over time

resolution: Schema grows by additive change (new optional fields ignored, new event kinds skipped on read = forward compat); a renamed event *kind* is migrated forward at events::upcast, the single read-path seam (backward compat), shape-detected so no version counter and no log-format change. Fields evolve additively only. Seeded with CommentAdded/Comment → ElementAnnotated.

label: Concurrency: ordering of appends from multiple clients

resolution: All appends serialize through one mutex in serve.rs so concurrent POST /comment handlers never interleave a half-written line and the log's order is causal.

label: Replay cost: rebuild per request, or cache the projection?

resolution: Cache the projection: version = fnv12(log bytes); reuse serve.rs's existing ring keyed on the log hash; replay only on a cache miss; compact caps replay length by folding to a snapshot.

label: Is model.json a derived snapshot, or gone entirely?

resolution: log-only (pure ES): model.json is derived & gitignored, never hand-edited; the log is the only write path; render & serve replay the log; an existing model.json bootstraps as a genesis batch of events. F-auto-genesis killed the legacy serve-from-model mode entirely.

label: Migrate the legacy comments.jsonl inbox into the log

resolution: faceto genesis folds a sibling comments.jsonl after the model's genesis batch: each stored comment maps through events::comment_to_events (the same mapping the live server uses) into ElementAnnotated/HotspotResolved/ElementRenamed/ElementMoved/ElementRemoved. Best-effort: blank/unparseable/elemId-less lines are skipped and counted.

label: Can regions overlap or leave holes?

resolution: No. Regions are a contiguous partition of the timeline. Frontier moves set one border and replay's normalize re-borders the neighbour atomically; legacy independent spans (PhaseResized) are projected onto a gap-free, overlap-free partition too. Remove = merge under the partition (the neighbour absorbs the freed columns; a board-end removal extends the outermost survivor).
